name: Amr Bashir
cvTagline: Fullstack Software Engineer | Rust, TypeScript, Cross-Platform Desktop
summary: Fullstack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building cross-platform desktop, web, and mobile applications. Core maintainer of Tauri, an open-source app framework with 90K+ GitHub stars used by thousands of production apps. Specialized in Rust, TypeScript, and native OS integrations (Win32, GTK, X11). Proven track record shipping production software end-to-end, from systems-level APIs to React/SolidJS frontends.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.short: Tauri-based collaborative AI development app with CEF runtime. Windows sandboxing for untrusted code via syscall hooks. Plugin architecture and native UX on Windows and macOS.
bullets: Contributed to Zephyr Agency, a Tauri-based collaborative AI development app built on the Chromium Embedded Framework (CEF) runtime.
Built Windows sandboxing for agents for untrusted code execution: a sandbox DLL with syscall hooks, and violation reporting.
Contributed to and improved the plugin (mini-apps) architecture for better extensibility and isolation.
Helped implement CEF runtime support in upstream Tauri: feature work, public APIs, and cross-platform stability fixes across Windows and macOS.
Polished native window UX on Windows and macOS: transparency, macOS corner radius, custom titlebar with drag regions, hide-to-tray/dock.

roles.title: Fullstack Engineer · ERP System
roles.short: Designed and delivered a complete ERP — inventory, invoicing, transactions. tRPC + Postgres + Prisma backend, React frontend with i18n.
bullets: Designed and shipped a full ERP system covering inventory, invoicing, customer records, and transactions for a local retail business.
Built a type-safe backend with tRPC, PostgreSQL, and Prisma; modeled multi-entity schema with referential integrity.
Implemented React frontend with Vite, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, and i18next for Arabic/English localization.
Delivered production-ready system end-to-end as sole engineer.

roles.title: Windows Software Engineer
roles.short: Windows-specific features for a Tauri desktop app, including sidebar integration and a COM-API bridge to Microsoft Excel.
bullets: Shipped Windows-specific features for a Tauri-based desktop app, including OS-wide sidebar integration.
Integrated app with Microsoft Excel through the COM API for live spreadsheet interop.
Improved native Windows UX by leveraging Win32 APIs for shell integration.

roles.title: R&D Software Engineer
roles.short: Maintained Tauri across Windows, Linux, and macOS. Built a cloud platform on Axum, Rspc, MongoDB, SolidJS. Integrated the Ory suite (Kratos, Hydra, Keto) for auth.
bullets: Maintained and extended the Tauri project (90K+ GitHub stars), focusing on performance, stability, and cross-platform parity across Windows, Linux (X11/GTK), and macOS.
Contributed to a cloud platform built with Rust (Axum, Rspc), MongoDB, and SolidJS, implementing backend endpoints and frontend UI.
Integrated user management and authorization using the Ory suite (Kratos, Hydra, Keto) for SSO, OAuth2, and fine-grained permissions.
Collaborated with a distributed engineering team via async code review and design discussions.

roles.title: Mobile Engineer · POS System
roles.short: Flutter-based offline-first Point of Sale for iOS and Android.
bullets: Developed a Flutter-based Point of Sale system for iOS and Android with a companion admin dashboard.
Built local server, embedded database, and device-to-device communication layer for offline-first operation.

education.title: B.A. English Literature
education.short: Studied literature and translation. Built software on the side, which gradually became the foreground.
